name: Awesome Spears
description:
突进附魔太爱吃饭了，它怎么吃得比我还多？突进长矛看起来是个很好的鞘翅起飞装置，但它居然不能在空中用？附了突进的长矛自带的这么好的加速手段，居然不能和右键的冲锋一起用？我长矛击退哪去了？为什么怪在我攻击范围里我戳不到它？明明我瞄着天，为什么还是只能横着冲？为什么我在水里冲不动？相信我，安装这个模组之后，以上的烦恼统统会烟消云散的。希望如此。

The Lunge enchantment is an absolute glutton - how does it manage to consume even more than I do? The Lunge spear seems like a perfect tool for taking flight with an elytra, but why it’s unusable while airborne? And why can’t I combine the built-in speed boost from the enchantment with the spear’s own right-click charge attack? Where did the knockback go? Why can’t I land a hit on a mob that’s clearly within my attack range? Hey, I’m aiming toward the sky, but why do I still end up dashing sideways? And why can’t I seem to move forward when I’m in the water? Trust me: once you install this mod, all these frustrations will vanish into thin air. Hopefully.
